checks.text: A wage is set for the job

shots.caption: Wage, then craftsman, then advance, then start

notes: The checklist says no job goes out before the wage is agreed. On this screen "Give the job" was available before a wage had been set, so the rule was not enforced here.
did: Looked at the owner's page for the order of steps: the wage is set before the job is given and started.
